composition.mergeStates: Reject duplicate names; add extension states to base states.
composition.transitions: Append explicit recommendations before base wildcard fall/result/reset rules; keep base priorities.
composition.eventInputs: Union of base and extension input names.
composition.initialState: Keep the existing game initial state; start_gate is an optional presentation entry.
composition.runtimeIntegration: Assets only; no runtime loader, gameplay code or version query strings changed.

contactUnits.supportContacts: Foot effectors only, ski-slide, full-load windows; unchanged viewer acquires/releases over 0.06 seconds.
contactUnits.equipmentContacts: Instant markers; optional startTime/endTime for held grab.
contactUnits.groundContacts: Actual snow contact windows, including pole tips and body support. These do not become viewer foot IK constraints.
contactUnits.attachmentContacts: Boot-to-ski and hand-to-pole attachments. During the grab the left pole is retained by its wrist strap.
contactUnits.events: Presentation only; never modify score, physics, rewards or authoritative heading.

spin180Exit: Use the authoritative facing snapshot to rebase the displayed pose at completion before blending to land_perfect. Preserve the world pose; never add the rotation a second time or unwind the half-turn. See the transition headingHandoff record.
